# Build Log

Course: DBIZ3 AI-native Product Development, Sessions 8 to 11
Team: Team C    Product: CINEMATCH

Save as `docs/build/build-log.md`. Add one entry for every agent run that created or changed a
file in `specs/`, `src/` (or your code folder) or `tests/`. Write it right after the run, not at
the end of the day. The build log is how the instructors, and your teammates, see what the agent
did and what the humans decided.

## 4. Agent mistakes worth remembering

| Entry | What went wrong | How it was caught | Prevention |
|---|---|---|---|
| Entry 1 | Initial draft of `tasks.md` placed domain scoring implementation in Foundational phase before unit test tasks in US-1 phase. | Caught during Step 3 checklist review against Constitution Principle II. | Ensure all business rule and acceptance scenario tests strictly precede implementation tasks in execution order. |
| Entry 2 | `getLocationImages` in `lib/db/locations.js` ordered by `image_id`, a column `location_image` does not have; the query would fail on first use. | Found in Entry 6 when the detail page first read photos. | Fixed to `image_url`; check column names against `data/schema/` when writing a query. |
| Entry 6 | The T031 test first used `admin` as an example of an unknown role, but `admin` is a valid role in `ck_user_account_role`. | Caught when the contact role list was given (SYS Clarifications Q1). | Take role names from `data/schema/schema-SYS.sql`, not from the mock helper. |
| Entry 7 | The first `build_docs.py --mermaid` run on a machine without mermaid-cli rewrote the *Every Mermaid block renders* checklist line to *NOT verified* in all nine specs. | Seen in the diff before going on. | Rerun with mermaid-cli 11.14 through `MMDC_PATH`; check the diff of `docs/spec/` after every rebuild. |
| Entry 8 | The first draft of `data-model.md` said saving a contact clears `verified_by`; the schema has it NOT NULL, and research R6 claimed the seed slugs come from `name_en` (they do not). | Re-read of `schema-M3.sql` and the seed before writing the contract. | Check every claim about columns and seed values against `data/` before writing it into a spec artifact. |
| Entry 8 | `verified_at` and `logged_at` were first written in UTC, so a verification at 06:05 in Vietnam showed *29/10/2026*. | Seen in the SC-35 browser run. | Timestamps are written with `+07:00`, like the seed (`nowInVietnam()` in `lib/db/audit.js`). |
| Entry 9 | `SET search_path = 'public, extensions'` in quotes names one schema, so `app_match_locations` could not find the vector operator; the migration had only been checked statically. | First `db push` on `cinematch-dev`. | A static test now refuses a quoted schema list; migrations with functions are run on a real PostgreSQL before they are reported done. |
| Entry 9 | The seed loader ran its multi-statement block through `npx supabase db query`, which uses a prepared statement (one command). | First `seed-supabase.mjs --reset`. | One parameterless `client.query(sql)` with `pg`; check how a tool sends SQL before relying on it. |
| Entry 9 | `check:supabase` and `test:rls` expected 0 rows from tables `anon` has no GRANT on, so the stricter refusal (42501) was reported as FAIL; the app read paths also turned it into a 500. | First `check:supabase` run. | Tests of access control accept *refused* and *0 rows*; read paths map 42501 to *no access*. |
| Entry 9 | The agent first counted 10 published seed locations and 63 provinces; the seed has 9 and 34. | The new test of `seedPublishedLocations()` and a count of `12_province.csv`. | Count seed values with a script, never by eye. |
| Entry 10 | The online suite `tests/rls/rls.test.js` (Entry 9) deletes its sign-up fixtures' `user_account`, `profile` and `consent` but not their `producer_organisation`, so each `npm run test:rls` leaves orphan *RLS Test Films* rows (10 on `cinematch-dev` now). | Row counts after the slice-2 online run. | Clean up every row a fixture's trigger creates; fix the suite's cleanup in a reviewed change. |
| Entry 10 | A 360 px screenshot in headless Chrome looked cut off: Chrome keeps a 500 px minimum window, so the page was laid out at 500 px. | `innerWidth` printed 500. | Check narrow layouts inside an iframe of the exact width. |
| Entry 11 | The landing page's `<meta name="description">` came from the site layout and said *operated for VFDA*, against Clarifications Q3; the landing test only read the page body. | The closing run on `cinematch-dev` looked for "VFDA" in the whole HTML head. | A Q3 test now checks the page's own title and description; check `<head>` as well as the body for wording rules. |
| Entry 11 | Code comments that quoted the forbidden words ("Article 13", "VFDA") made the source-scanning landing test fail twice. | The test itself. | Write comments that describe the rule without quoting the forbidden text. |
| Entry 11 | The first timing of the router read 5.2 s: the wait condition never matched, so the timeout was measured. | The number did not fit 5 clicks; the condition was checked. | Check that a measurement's stop condition can be met before trusting the number. |
| Entry 12 | `tasks.md` T005 said *The Last Ferry* has a 50 % dossier with two missing components; the seed has 1 of 4 present (25 %) and three missing. | The seed oracle `seed_rules.readiness()` run for every project while writing the test. | T005 corrected; US-2 Scenario 1 is tested on *Rice and Salt* in a rolled-back transaction. Compute expected values from the seed oracle, never from the scenario text. |
| Entry 12 | Two new tests passed before any code existed: *unknown dialect is refused* (the missing module made the import reject) and *a pending invitation gives no access* (it only read the seed). | The Red run: a test that passes in the Red phase was checked. | Both rewritten to call the code under test; every green test in a Red run is read again. |
| Entry 13 | Three test files passed the first time they ran (T030 for node:sqlite, T036, T037): their code had been written earlier with T012 and T019–T020, so the order was code first. | The Red run of each phase: a test that passes before its code is read again. | Write the data-layer functions only in the task that follows their test; when a test is green at once, say so in the log. |
| Entry 13 | `build_docs.py --mermaid` ran with an `MMDC_PATH` that no longer existed and rewrote the *Every Mermaid block renders* line to *NOT verified* in all nine specs — the Entry 7 mistake again. | `start_feature.py --check` reported drift for spec-M0. | Check that `mmdc --version` answers before every `--mermaid` run; rerun with mermaid-cli 11.14.0 (done, no diff left in `docs/spec/`). |
| Entry 13 | Adding `readiness_source` renumbered the seed files, and `scripts/lib/supabase-check.mjs` had `21_location.csv` written in, so its test failed. | `npm test` after the rebuild. | Find seed files by table name, never by their NN prefix. |
| Entry 13 | `GET /api/projects/undefined` answered 500 and `/readiness` 503 (a malformed uuid reached the database). | The walk-through on `cinematch-dev`. | Routes with an `:id` answer 404 for an id that is not a uuid (tests in both contract files). |
| Entry 14 | A replacement in `tools/specs_b.py` searched from the start of the file instead of the M7 block and deleted 549 lines; the agent first called the resulting SC-17/18 `check_screens` errors pre-existing. | The diff size, then the errors traced to the broken file. | File restored with `git checkout`, edits redone inside the M7 block, every hunk checked to lie in it; scope every scripted edit to its block, and never call an error pre-existing without checking `git stash`/`HEAD`. |
| Entry 14 | `MMDC_PATH` pointed to a removed wrapper and `build_docs.py --mermaid` again wrote *NOT verified* into the nine specs (the Entry 7 and 13 mistake). | The diff of `docs/spec/`. | mermaid-cli 11.14.0 reinstalled in the scratch folder and the build rerun; `mmdc --version` before every `--mermaid` run. |
| Entry 14 | The T010 test assumed the .docx is zipped with JSZip; `docx` 9 uses `fflate`. | The test could not open the file. | Test switched to `fflate`; check how a library builds its output before testing it. |
| Entry 14 | `app.notice_summary` used `string_agg(DISTINCT … ORDER BY …)` with an order expression not in the argument list, which PostgreSQL refuses. | The PGlite run before the migration was reported done. | DISTINCT subquery; every function migration runs on a real PostgreSQL first (Entry 9 rule kept). |
| Entry 14 | T013 and T028 were green the first time they ran: their routes had been written in T021 before the tests. | The Red run of each test file. | Write a route only in the task that follows its test. |
| Entry 14 | The print page's inline CSS (`@media print { header, footer … }`) was read as interface text by the hard-coded-text test. | `tests/unit/i18n-no-hardcoded.test.js`. | `<style media="print">` with compact CSS; no test changed. |
| Entry 15 | `tests/unit/m4-seed.test.js` (T003) was written after the generator change, and T027 (input), T035 (profile data) and T055 (private layer) were green the first time they ran, because their code had come earlier (input helpers with T013, the profile functions with T042, the private-layer twin with T019). | The Red run of each test file. | The Entry 13 and 14 rule again: write a function only in the task after its test; say so when a test is green at once. |
| Entry 15 | A `sed` change of the audit action `verification.approve` → `org.verify.approve` also renamed the notification event `verification.approved`. | The notification tests. | Event names restored; scope replacements to the whole token (`\b…\b` or the quoted string). |
| Entry 15 | New tests first assumed seed facts that were wrong: Park cannot be used for *one NDA row is not enough* (Park reads Hạ Long Marine through *Quiet Harbour Blues*), the rate card is a JSON object not a list, and two `role.grant` dates came before their admin's account existed. | The test runs and `check_seed.py`. | JIWOO used instead of Park; the assertions read the object; dates moved after 01/06/2026. Check the seed with a query before writing an expected value. |
| Entry 15 | `app_send_collab_request` answered `NOT_FOUND` to a partner who is not on the project; the contract says 403. | T047 / T048. | The code was changed (not the test): `NOT_FOUND` only for an unknown project. |
| Entry 16 | A placeholder replacement (`REPL`) also changed part of `REPLY_CHOICES` in four M7 files. | The diff of files outside the feature. | The four files restored from `HEAD` (their diffs were only the damage); use unique placeholders and check `git diff --stat` after a scripted edit. |
| Entry 16 | `lib/content-check/input.js` imports `node:crypto`, and client screens imported it through `lib/content-check/view.js`; `npm test` passed, `npm run build` failed. | The build at the close-out. | Word count and constants moved to `lib/content-check/words.js`; run `npm run build` after each new client screen. |
| Entry 16 | The SC-30 segment filter first had segment labels written by the agent. | Self-check before the run. | Replaced by the existing `router.segment.*` texts from the PRD; take labels from existing keys or the spec. |
| Entry 16 | `next start` read `.env`, so the offline smoke test read (read only) the old `cinematch-dev` data. | `segment=C` returned 0 rules (no `segments` column there yet). | Offline smoke runs with `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=` empty. |
| Entry 16 | Two tests were green for the wrong reason (the keywords column test and the dossier banned-words test), and three test bugs: an `assert.rejects` validator returning a string, a case-sensitive uuid pattern, an `ORDER BY revision` before the column existed. | The Red runs. | Each test first asserts that the column or key it reads exists; validators return `true`. |
| Entry 16 | *passed* in the English deadline texts is a banned word (BR-003). | The banned-words test. | English reworded; the Screen Spec example is row 66. |
| Entry 18 | The first version of the import-time rule in `build-dynamic.test.js` flagged `const url = () => process.env…` (the arrow-function exclusion backtracked over the space), so it was red for the wrong reason. | The offender list named arrow functions. | Regex fixed and checked on six sample lines (four real offenders caught, two arrow functions passed). |
| Entry 19 | `build_docs.py --mermaid` would again have run with a removed `MMDC_PATH` (the scratch folder had been cleared); this time `mmdc --version` was checked first, mermaid-cli 11.14.0 was reinstalled and no spec was marked *NOT verified*. | The version check before the build. | Keep checking `mmdc --version` before every `--mermaid` build. |
| Entry 19 | Several tests were green for the wrong reason or wrong at first: the requirement-code test of `m5-seed` passed with an empty loop; two test files split CSV on raw commas; the countdown access test lacked a `user_account` row; `document_type` texts used the banned word *accepted*. | The Red runs and the banned-words test. | Each test asserts that the column or row it reads exists; the CSV parser of `lib/db/client.js` or a full one; reworded texts. |
| Entry 19 | The PGlite base script removed Lan's NDA row before the draft flows ran, so they reported `NOT_FOUND`; a subquery read the glossary in the same statement as the function that wrote it. | The flows contradicted the helper check above them. | Restore any row a check removes; read results in a separate statement. |
| Entry 19 | The rest of T048 (FR-008, the passed date, static checks, 404) was written after its route (T049) and was green at once. | The order of the tasks. | Write every part of a test task before the code task that names it. |
| Entry 19 | `withTransaction` could not run inside a test's own transaction (`cannot start a transaction within a transaction`). | The D4 confirm test. | It now nests with a savepoint; the test was not changed. |
| Entry 19 | test RLS M2 không cập nhật khi thêm p_lang; phát hiện khi chạy test:rls ở lát M5 — the two M2 calls of `app_save_content_check` in `tests/rls/rls.test.js` still passed 4 arguments after the function gained `p_lang` (5 arguments, migration `20261108000100_m2_check.sql`). | `npm run test:rls` run by Nam Tran on the M5 slice (11/11/2026). | Only the calls changed (`p_lang: 'en'`, the test texts are English); no assertion, migration or application code changed. When a function gains a parameter, search `tests/rls/` for its calls too. |
